name: grafiks
format:
<html>
<iframe id="myFrame" width="850px" height="400px"
    style="overflow:hidden; margin:auto; border:0px solid green;"></iframe>

<script>
    (function(scope) {
    scope.$watch('msg', function(msg) {
        if (!msg || !msg.payload) return;
        
        var p = msg.payload;
        var hostname = location.hostname;
        
        var ip;
        if (hostname === p.internalIP || hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '127.0.0.1') {
            ip = p.internalIP;
        } else {
            ip = p.tailscaleIP;
        }
        
        var src = `http://${ip}:3000${p.basePath}${p.query}`;
        
        var x = document.getElementById('myFrame');
        x.setAttribute('src', src);
    });
})(scope);
</script>

</html>
